placements.why: Both segments describe test artifacts — the e2e suite and the probe memory — whose function is to assert and carry a behavioral contract. This names the organizational category of proof artifacts that verify system rules, which nothing existing covers.
placements.title: test artifacts assert and carry behavioral contracts
placements.frame: What behavioral contracts do test artifacts verify, and what instrumental role do the artifacts themselves play in carrying those assertions?

placements.title: an action enrolls its performer in a role
placements.frame: Does performing a system action automatically allocate a role to the actor by virtue of having performed it?
placements.why: src-1 states the rule that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer; src-2 subordinates the probe memory's entire existence to carrying that assertion. Together they support the theme that a system action automatically allocates a role to its performer — a subject future envelopes can keep feeding.
